# Tamer Avci

> Founder of Hunter Technologies and former AWS software engineer based in Seattle, WA. Builds commercial software applications and occasionally takes on high-impact consulting projects.

Tamer Avci is a software engineer and founder based in Seattle, Washington. He runs his own company, Hunter Technologies, where he builds commercial software applications, and occasionally takes on short, high-impact consulting projects with startups solving difficult technical problems. He is well versed in LLM-based coding assistants, CLIs, and IDEs, and uses agentic coding to amplify his impact so he can focus on solving the right problem, aligning people, and mentoring junior engineers.

He was previously a Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS), focused on payments and security across web-based distributed and embedded systems. He designed and built services that scaled cleanly and predictably and stayed extensible and maintainable for other engineers, and worked closely with product and business teams to turn vague requirements into clear technical solutions.

He has a niche specialty in JavaCard applets and smart-card standards (GlobalPlatform, EMVCo, ISO 7816/14443, Mifare) for identity, transit, and payments. He was born and raised in Istanbul, Turkey, attended Istanbul Erkek Lisesi, and studied Computer Science at Emory University in Atlanta. Outside of work he tinkers with self-hosting and infrastructure, follows Seattle sports, plays basketball, and explores craft beers.

## Currently working on
- [Header](https://joinheader.com/): Helps both people and their AI agents keep up with everything that matters. For agents, it is an optimization layer: point Header at your agentic codebase and it continuously generates hypotheses to reduce token spend and improve reliability, runs experiments, and merges statistically significant wins back into the agent's harness configuration. For humans, it is an AI-native RSS reader.
- [Hunter Technologies](https://huntertechhq.com/): The other apps and services Tamer builds and offers.

## AWS experience
- [Amazon One](https://one.amazon.com/): The world's fastest, fully contactless biometric-based entry and payment system
- [Amazon Go](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Go): The first-ever computer-vision-based checkoutless store
- [Amazon Books](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Books): Amazon's physical retail bookstore
